classifications.rationale: The President directed military forces to undertake an operational deployment and specified the support mission; this is discretionary executive and Commander-in-Chief management, not a self-executing change in legal rights or a mandated later agency legal outcome.
classifications.evidence: I directed a limited number of U.S. military forces to deploy to East Timor

classifications.rationale: The President authorized deployment of military assets and described their operational scope and anticipated duration. The consequence is executive military management, while the accompanying congressional report does not create a legal-rights consequence.
classifications.evidence: I authorized the deployment of the amphibious ship, USS BELLEAU WOOD (LHA 3), and her embarked helicopters
